items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: At that time Art Hickman was the rage. In California you see. So he wanted me to play music like Art Hickman.

ctx.x: I'm sure you cut the name.

Yeah. No it was the West End Roof. And that used to be a popular place out there. For all the college kids you know. So was. So was my place. That's the high. It was funny how I come to leave. Yeah. We'd been there for about two years. Two years and a half. So they changed managers. They got some guy from California. By the name of Johnson. Come in as manager you see. And at that time Art Hickman was the rage. In California you see. So he wanted me to play music like Art Hickman. So. All we used to get up there…
